title: seed false Rika tip
context: During the Rabbit exam Kiyotaka encounters Manabe after a group discussion and exploits her anger at Karuizawa.
observed_actions: Deliberately lies to Manabe that he may have seen Karuizawa bully Rika; afterward admits privately that he actually witnessed nothing.
observed_result: Manabe becomes interested and Kiyotaka expects escalation against Karuizawa; the subsequent harassment is a separate actor action.
epistemic_limits: A planted untruth and harmful provocation. No witness corroboration of original Rika accusation; not a legitimate or endorsed persuasion strategy.
information_available: Kiyotaka knows he did not observe the claimed incident; Manabe hears the misleading claim and does not know it is fabricated.
counterfactual_test: Other students may challenge fabrication, stop confrontation or report malicious conduct; do not require induced harm.
